home.title: Migration Policy Watch
home.subtitle: Factual, sourced tracking of parties, laws and elections related to immigration policy across Western democracies.
home.scopeText: EU27, United Kingdom, Norway, Switzerland, Iceland, United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Argentina. Selection by political criterion (Western democracies with active anti-immigration movements), not ethnic.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.intro: This site documents parties, laws and elections related to migration policy across Western democracies. Every classification is sourced and verifiable.

elections.title: Electoral tracker
elections.intro: National, regional, local and by-elections, all levels.

legislation.title: Legislative tracker
legislation.intro: Anti-immigration laws enacted or under advanced discussion, by country and at EU level.

news.title: News
news.intro: Developments in migration policy outside the directory: citizen and activist initiatives, closed communities, court cases, elections and referendums. Journalistic treatment: nature, developments, legal status.

footer.sources: Sources: Manifesto Project, ParlGov, PopuList, EUR-Lex, IPU Parline.
footer.notice: Journalistic and documentary content. No personal data is collected for targeting. Every classification is sourced and verifiable — see the methodology.

meta.siteTitle: Migration Policy Watch — parties, laws and elections
meta.siteDescription: Factual, sourced tracking of parties, laws and elections related to immigration policy across Western democracies.
meta.partiesDescription: Sourced profiles of parties whose platform or academic classification centres on reducing immigration or on remigration: electoral standing, history, footprint.

contact.title: Contact and corrections
contact.intro: This site is a monitoring tool: a reported error that proves real is corrected, and the correction is made public.
contact.reportText: Write to <mail>{email}</mail> stating the page, the contested statement and, if possible, a source. Every report is checked against a specific source. A confirmed error is corrected on the page and recorded in the corrections log, with its date and nature.
contact.replyText: Anyone named or referred to on this site may exercise the right of reply provided for by French law no. 2004-575 of 21 June 2004 (LCEN), by writing to the address above.

corrections.title: Corrections log
corrections.intro: Every published error later corrected, every fact withdrawn and every change of classification, newest first, with the source the correction rests on. Rewording, new data and design changes are not listed.
